svg.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
svg.text: Solder-side view: you are looking at the cups. The top row (1 to 13) is the far row.
Male numbering runs right to left, female left to right: the two ends of a cable are mirror images.
dashed ring: ground or 5 V pin, put two wires in the cup
unused pin: leave the cup empty
